Author: OpenCodexMicro
Name: Antigravity
Overview: Control Antigravity VS Code agent tasks, plans, and actions from Ulanzi D200 Series in Ulanzi Studio.
Description:
Turn Ulanzi D200 Series into a dedicated Antigravity AI Agent control surface through Ulanzi Studio.

FEATURES
- View recent Antigravity sessions with live status and elapsed execution timer.
- One-touch Proceed / Approve Plan and Cancel / Stop actions.
- Attention alert badge jumping directly to threads needing feedback.
- Active Subagents monitor and direct Plan / Walkthrough inspectors.
- Use the Latest Session & Scroll Encoder action to switch session and scroll VS Code.
- Keep communication local through loopback-only endpoints.
